title: Easy Baked Caesar Chicken Sandwiches
ingredients: Salt-free garlic and herb seasoning (to taste)
~2 cups crushed croutons or Italian-style bread crumbs
instructions: Take 3 large chicken breasts and cut in half horizontally, making 6 thin pieces. Season well with salt-free garlic and herb seasoning.
Set up two bowls: add 1 1/2 cups Caesar dressing to one bowl, and about 2 cups of crushed croutons (or Italian-style bread crumbs) to the other.
Dip each piece of chicken in the dressing, then the crumb mixture. Lay on a well-greased cookie sheet and spray the tops with a little oil.
Bake at 425°F for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and add freshly shredded Parmesan cheese on top of each piece. Return to oven and broil for 1 minute.
Take a Caesar salad kit from the store and make it up as you normally would.
Toast burger buns with a little garlic butter.
Assemble the sandwiches: place chicken on the bottom bun, top with Caesar salad, then add the top bun.
notes: Recipe by Andrea (verified Facebook creator). Original reel caption: 'Another really easy dinner that I love!!' — recipe text found in author's pinned comment. Commenters suggest using Parmesan instead of bread crumbs for a variation.
